narrative.overview: White and cool silver working surfaces, ink typography and violet actions make a connected creation workflow understandable. Outfit gives the interface a rounded, confident voice; coastal creator photography supplies the human context. A charcoal media editor sits inside the light page, and an explicit dark theme remains available. Landing chapters are spacious; studio screens use compact controls, readable scripts and familiar navigation. This system records the built hackathon prototype without production or compliance claims.
keyCharacteristics: Clear violet actions and softly tinted selected states.
Open working areas, fine borders and softly inset media.
Visible distinctions between illustrative demos, drafts and verified exports.

rules.name: The Action Violet Rule
rules.body: Use violet for actions, focus and selection. Let neutrals carry the working surface and hierarchy.

rules.name: The Readable Script Rule
rules.body: Use larger manuscript type and generous leading for spoken text; keep tool labels subordinate.

rules.name: The Working Plane Rule
rules.body: Keep rows and ordinary containers quiet; reserve ambient lift for media and overlays.

dos: Do keep light and dark scenes coherent through semantic CSS variables.
Do use native controls, visible labels, SVG icons and clear focus outlines.
Do give scripts reading space and tools predictable placement.
Do label illustrative imagery and examples and preserve source/version distinctions.
Do keep playback controls outside captions and honor reduced motion.
donts: Don't introduce invented proof, metrics, prices or unsupported controls.
Don't turn small demo metadata into default body type.
Don't hide meaningful story text with unreadable initial opacity.
Don't replace functional UI with screenshots, glyph icons or unlabeled actions.
Don't add hard offset shadows, decorative eyebrows or a new accent family.
